steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Star hopping uses easily recognisable patterns (like the Plough) to locate fainter objects | Key Fact: A planisphere is a rotating star map that shows which constellations are visible at a given date and time | Key Fact: Angular separation can be estimated using hand measurements: little finger at arm's length ≈ 1°, fist ≈ 10° | Key Fact: Seeing conditions depend on atmospheric turbulence, light pollution and transparency

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from observing techniques, and one past-paper question.
